text:
The original tale ends with Kai merging his spirit with the magic, becoming one with it and saving the world, but at the cost of his human existence. Alternative Ending: Instead of dissolving into the ether, Kai realizes that the ancient magic does not require a vessel, but rather a conductor. He channels the chaotic energy not into himself, but into the ley lines of the earth itself, creating a permanent, self-sustaining network of balance. The surge of power knocks him unconscious, but when he wakes, he is still human, his body scarred but intact. The world is saved, not by his sacrifice, but by his choice to remain and guide the new equilibrium, proving that the chosen one’s role is not to end, but to endure.

The capital of France is Paris.
